name: a-restart-bumps-the-generation
description: A start with the same port and token while the bind is ready does nothing; any other start stops first, cancelling every connection, and binds with a new generation. Bind reports, accepts and bytes of the old listener are dropped; deliveries carry the generation they belong to. A start before the bind is ready restarts it.
reason: A settings refresh must not drop connected devices (HK-289), and nothing from a torn-down listener may be attributed to its successor (HK-291).
source: rust/powerup-core/src/protocol/listener.rs, ported from Sources/PowerUp/RemoteListener.swift at 4c7abe6:79-152 (start, stop), 154-156, 259-275 (generation checks)
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.4, v1.7, v2.15; docs/protocol.md spec v0. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/listener.rs listener_scenarios plays every step through protocol::listener::Listener. Swift: Tests/PowerUpTests/ListenerScenarioTests.swift testEveryListenerScenario plays every step through the bridge (CoreBridge.ListenerPolicy), and ProtocolServerTests drives the same policy over a real loopback socket.

steps.reason: Settings start the listener: the start stops first (generation 1), then binds 127.0.0.1 with generation 2 (RemoteListener.swift:79-135).
The bind is ready: running, no problem (RemoteListener.swift:158-161).
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 1 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).
The same port and token while ready: nothing (RemoteListener.swift:80).
A new token: stop (generation 3), cancelling the listener and connection 1, then bind with generation 4.
Bytes of the cancelled connection are dropped.
A socket the old listener accepted: refused.
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 2 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).

steps.reason: A hook post with the new token is delivered with generation 4.
Stop: generation 5, the listener and connection 2 cancelled.
Nothing is accepted after a stop.
Stopping again is safe: nothing left to cancel.
The same start before the bind is ready is no no-op: the bind restarts (generations 9 and 10).
